title: Superpower voices row
description: A two-line headline over a sideways-scrolling row of tall rounded media cards of mixed widths, like a social wall: portrait and landscape photos with a dark fade at the foot carrying a white caption, a bold source name or a creator handle with a follower count, a frosted play button on videos, and stacked pairs of a short photo over a grey press-quote card. Round arrow buttons scroll it on desktop.
notes: the caption fade and play button force the dark class on themselves so they stay dark-on-photo in any theme
